message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1.  **Notification/Status message bar below text input:** Yes. The exact text is: **"Select a chat before marking it unread."** (There is also a "Dismiss" button on the right).
2.  **'Sign in' card or modal:** Yes, there is a card in the center of the screen with the heading **"Sign in to get started"**.
3.  **Bottom-left footer text:** Yes. The exact text is: **"App-server online"** (preceded by a green dot icon).
4.  **Other transient message:** Yes, there is a toast or notification banner at the very bottom of the main content area containing the text: **"Select a chat before marking it unread."** (This corresponds to the bar mentioned in question #1).
